notes: Independent review: 18 units, no change. Superscription morphemes match PSA.4.0 (Chief Musician headed on Chief, medium); A Psalm is rightly added, since this superscription has no mizmor. Affirmed both flagged calls: the italicized as stays inside tsippor's unit and the plain to inside harkem's, because the adverbial accusative licenses them; heads bird and mountain. Medium on tsippor is right given the margin's vocative Or, ye birds.
